{{Event Infobox
| Name  = Wheel of Change
| Image = Event-SpinTheWheel.png
}}
{{E|Wheel of Change}} is a shrine [[Event]] found in all [[Acts]].

Shrine events appear less frequently than other acts.
{{Clear}}
== Options ==
<div style="float:right; display:flex; flex-direction:row; gap:10px; margin:0 0 10px 10px;">
[[File:SpinButton.png|100px|thumb|Spin Button.]]
[[File:WheelArrow.png|100px|thumb|Wheel arrow.]]
[[File:Wheel.png|250px|thumb|Wheel.]]
</div>
{{Frame|Play}}
* Spin a wheel containing the following "prizes" (clockwise starting at 12 o'clock in the image):
** Take 10% ({{Asc|15|15%}}) of your Max HP as damage.
** Gain [[Gold]]
** Gain a random [[Relic]]
** Heal to full HP
** Become Cursed - {{C|Decay}}
** Remove a card from your deck.

{{Clear}}

== Dialogue ==
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
You come upon a dapper looking, cheery gremlin. <br>
"It's time to spin the wheel! Are you {{TS||up|R E A D Y ?}} Of course you are!"
</div>
<blockquote>
When receiving a [[Relic]]
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
"Ah, a {{TS|green||gift!}} <br>
Enjoy!"
</div></blockquote>

When taking damage
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
"Uh oh! <br>
You lose!" <br>
You spot him readying a shiv...
</div></blockquote>
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
You slash at the crazy gremlin but he's simply too quick! <br>
He gets you a few times with a crude shiv. <br>
"The price has been paid!!" <br>
and with that, both the gremlin and its wheel disappear in a puff of smoke.
</div></blockquote>

When obtaining [[Gold]]
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
"You win some {{TS|gold||GOLD!}} <br>
YAY!!!!"
</div></blockquote>

When obtaining {{C|Decay}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
"Looks like you won a {{TS|purple||Curse!}} <br>
That's not good. <br>
Oh well! Better luck next time!"
</div></blockquote>

When removing a card from your deck
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
"Ohh, the power of {{TS|negative|up|darkness...}} <br>
Choose a card to remove from your deck!"
</div></blockquote>
</blockquote>
</blockquote>
